title: PDMS hydrogel-coated tissue culture plates for studying the impact of substrate stiffness on dendritic cell function
protocol: Weigh part A and part B of gel into a 50 mL conical tube.
Mix thoroughly by inverting the conical tube repeatedly for at least 3 min.
Coat the wells of the plate using a 10 mL serological pipette.
Ensure that the hydrogel solution fully covers the bottom of the plate.
Allow the hydrogel coated plate(s) to cure overnight (8–10 h) at 60°C in an incubator.
Sterilize the hydrogel coated plates by ultraviolet irradiation for at least 15 min using a UV Stratalinker.
Coat the hydrogel plates with extracellular matrix proteins (e.g., 1 μg/mL fibronectin in PBS).
Allow the proteins to adhere for 4 h at 37°C.
Wash the coated plates twice with PBS.
Hydrate the hydrogel plates with PBS after washing prior to seeding with cells.
Remove PBS from the plates before seeding them with cells.
Measure stiffness using AFM probe by nanoindentation on a JPK NanoWizard II atomic force microscope.
Alter the tip shape of a silicon nitride probe with a titanium dioxide-based tip modifier solution.
Spread the coating on a clean glass slide and create tiny streaks in a crisscross pattern.
Load the tip in the AFM.
Dab the coated tip in a streak of coating without submerging it.
Cure the coated AFM tip under UV-C at 120 mJ/cm² for 5 minutes.
Prop up the tip on its side under a microscope and image to estimate the radius of curvature of the indenter.
Perform ten nanoindentations per PDMS gel sample in phosphate buffer saline solution using the modified AFM tip in contact mode.
Set the applied force to 20 nN for measurements on both gels, achieving indentation depths ranging from 100-1500 nm.
Mix 1 mL of TTIP with 20 mL IPA to form a clear solution.
Slowly add the TTIP/IPA solution to 50 mL aqueous HCl (pH 1.2) under vigorous stirring.
Transfer the solution to a Teflon-lined hydrothermal reactor and heat at 160°C for 24 h.
Centrifuge the solution at 15,000×g for 1 minute.
Clean the precipitate with absolute ethanol.
Dry the powder at 70°C for 2 hours.
Disperse the powder in 10 mL of deionized water to complete the TiO2 nano solution.
Mix TEOS (4 mL), MSMA (1 mL), 13F (0.4 mL), TiO2 nano solution (1 mL), IPA (1 mL), and aqueous HCl (2 mL, pH 1.2) for 24 h to form a homogenous solution.
Mix MFTS, DPHA, and HMPP with the weight ratio of 110/1.67/0.21 to form a clear solution.
Place the spleen in a 5 cm plastic dish.
Mince the spleen into 1 mm pieces using curved scissors.
Transfer minced tissue to a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.
Add Collagenase 1-containing DMEM to achieve a final volume of 500 μL and concentration of 45 U/mL.
Incubate at 37°C for 45 min under continuous agitation (50 rpm).
Vortex the sample for 20 s after digestion.
Use repeated pipetting to thoroughly homogenize the tissue.
Pass the homogenized sample through a pre-wetted 40 μm cell strainer into a 50 mL conical tube.
Rinse the strainer with additional volumes of cell culture medium if necessary.
Proceed with centrifugation at 400 g for 5 min to pellet the single cell suspension.
Resuspend cells with 3 mL of ACK lysis buffer on ice for 3 min.
Stop lysis by adding more than 5 volumes of PBS and centrifuge cells at 400×g for 5 min.
Aspirate supernatant and resuspend the cells in 2 mL appropriate buffer for cell isolation.
Enumerate the magnetically isolated CD11c+ cells.
Seed cells at a density of 1.3 × 10^6 cells/mL in supplemented RPM-I cell culture medium into fibronectin/hydrogel-coated plates.
Culture the CD11c+ cells with stimuli of interest for appropriate lengths of time.
At end of culture, collect culture supernatant and harvest cells from the well with a cell scraper for the 50 kPa conditions for downstream applications.
Use repeated gentle pipetting to dislodge cells from the 2 kPa hydrogel plates.
After conditioning the magnetically isolated CD11c+ cells on PDMS hydrogels, perform downstream assays to metabolically profile these cells.
Conduct Agilent Seahorse extracellular flux analysis.
Profile metabolic pathway gene expression.
Profile protein expression of metabolic pathways.
Perform nutrient uptake assays.
Validate altered metabolic pathways by co-culturing CD11c+ cells with specific metabolic agonists or antagonists.
Analyze cell culture supernatants for nutrient depletion.
Measure metabolite production in cell culture supernatants using metabolomic footprinting assay.
